translations.web: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
translations.bsb: The watchman replies, “Morning has come, but also the night. If you would inquire, then inquire. Come back yet again.”
translations.kjv: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
translations.asv: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: turn ye, come.
